entities.name: Replayed NAS message container
entities.description: Information element used to re-send ATTACH REQUEST or TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST messages during ongoing attach or tracking area updating procedures when HASHMME mismatch occurs. Contains the original message without NAS security header.

entities.name: ATTACH REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message used by UE to initiate attach procedure. When included in Replayed NAS message container, it is coded without NAS security header.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message used by UE to initiate tracking area updating procedure. When included in Replayed NAS message container, it is coded without NAS security header.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE COMMAND
entities.description: NAS message that may contain HASHMME, triggering the need for replayed NAS message container when hash mismatch occurs.

entities.name: HASHMME
entities.description: Hash value included in SECURITY MODE COMMAND message, compared against UE's locally calculated hash value.

entities.name: HASHMME mismatch condition
entities.description: Condition where HASHMME in SECURITY MODE COMMAND differs from UE's locally calculated hash value, triggering replay of NAS message.

entities.name: No NAS security header
entities.description: Property indicating that replayed ATTACH REQUEST or TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST messages are coded without NAS security header.

entities.name: Replayed NAS message container IEI
entities.description: Information Element Identifier for Replayed NAS message container, located in bits 8-4 of octet 1.

entities.name: Length of Replayed NAS message container contents
entities.description: Length indicator for Replayed NAS message container contents, located in bits 8-1 of octets 2-3.

entities.name: Replayed NAS message container contents
entities.description: Actual content of the replayed NAS message, spanning octets 4 to n with maximum length of 65535 octets.

relations.description: Replayed NAS message container can contain ATTACH REQUEST message.
Replayed NAS message container can contain TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.
HASHMME mismatch condition establishes the need for Replayed NAS message container.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND message contains HASHMME information element.
HASHMME value guards the HASHMME mismatch condition.
ATTACH REQUEST message in Replayed NAS message container is coded without NAS security header.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message in Replayed NAS message container is coded without NAS security header.
Replayed NAS message container contains IEI field.
Replayed NAS message container contains length field.
Replayed NAS message container contains the actual message contents field.
